newsitem.title: USA: AT&T sues MCI in dispute over "true" trademark.
newsitem.headline: AT&T sues MCI in dispute over "true" trademark.

text.p: AT&T Corp. said on Monday it was suing telecommunications arch-rival MCI Communications Corp., alleging infringement of AT&T brand names that include the word "True."

AT&T said it filed in the United States District Court in New Jersey charging MCI with trademark infringement, unfair competition and trademark dilution over MCI's launch of a product called "MCI True Rate."
AT&T, which said it registered its trademark in 1992, is asking the court to bar MCI from using the word True, force it to destroy related marketing materials and pay damages.
AT&T has numerous service plans based on the word "True" including AT&T True Savings, AT&T True Voice and AT&T True Rewards.
MCI declined to comment. "As it is a matter of pending litigation, we cannot comment," a spokesman said.
